body: A framework for building and adapting models for speech recognition, text-to-speech, and spoken dialogue.
plain_description: **Build and adapt AI models for speech recognition, speech generation, and speech language tasks.** Use existing code and pretrained checkpoints to create, customize, and deploy speech models. Install from source, with pip, or using NVIDIA’s Docker container.
technical_description: A Python and PyTorch framework for researchers and developers working on automatic speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), and speech LLMs. Supports creating, customizing, and deploying models using pretrained checkpoints. Requires Python 3.12+ and PyTorch 2.7+; NVIDIA GPU with CUDA is required for training and recommended for inference, though CPU is an option.
title: NVIDIA NeMo Speech
